milestone: N3-C branch/tag resolution and stable owner-local pins
implementation: Restricted revision spelling accepts exact commits, unqualified branch/tag names and explicit refs/heads or refs/tags; no revision expressions or implicit HEAD
Local lookup reads bounded selected loose/packed ref data, honors loose overrides and peels tags in an isolated object database without source Git config/hooks
Remote exact-pattern ls-remote shares isolated HTTP(S), TLS, timeout and capture policy; selected candidates pass verified commit snapshot import
Branch/tag ambiguity fails even for identical targets; annotated tags supported and noncommit targets rejected
Format-2 lock records requested rev plus selected commit on every root/private edge; source snapshots and nominal identities remain exact-commit keyed
Unchanged owner/alias/repository/revision requests retain pins across moved refs and unrelated manifest changes; new owners/requests resolve separately
Frozen/offline builds and reinstalls reuse exact lock selections; graph cycles and failed resolution preserve old activation

expandedGraphSanitizerChecks.reason: Final fixture routes normal per-owner graph installation/changes/failures through the debug or ASan/UBSan API, while frozen/offline and public remote installation still exercise CLI paths

coverage: Loose/packed branches and lightweight/nested annotated tags; loose overrides, explicit namespaces and ambiguous equal-target names
Invalid expressions/abbreviations/HEAD/shell spellings, missing/noncommit refs, bounded packed listings and rejected symbolic/symlink ref paths
Source config attack marker remains absent during local resolution; remote config/TLS isolation and trusted/untrusted ref lookup
Root branch and private tag move without changing existing selections; unrelated additions, alias changes and new library owners retain or select pins independently
Actual ref-dependent dependency cycles and ambiguous new requests fail without changing the existing lock
Controlled HTTP/TLS advertisements, bounded stdout and actual stalled-ref timeout; frozen fresh checkout uses old commit after remote branch moves
Origins/servers disappear before cache-only checking/builds; generated CPU worker modes preserve expected old/new owner results
Format-2 strict lock validation plus previous package/project/library/snapshot/overlay and installed-tool regressions
Existing Metal imports/source protection and installed compiler use remain qualified; no actual GPU execution added

publicGitHubProbe.result: System TLS branch lookup and exact snapshot extraction succeeded, then correctly rejected missing native library manifest with zero published snapshots

limitations: No named update command, authenticated/SSH transport, symbolic local refs, arbitrary revision expressions, signed-tag verification or version range solving
Remote annotated tags use advertised peeled targets, verified as selected commit snapshots; tag object signature authentication is not implemented
Ref lookup and exact source import are separate operations; concurrent moves/object disappearance can fail cleanly, without cross-server atomic selection
Experimental public lock format 1 is rejected rather than migrated; existing exact-commit snapshot metadata/keys remain unchanged
Selected regressions, not the full native suite; no new actual GPU execution or broader installed Metal qualification
No new crash/fsync/hostile filesystem guarantees; existing per-process budgets do not establish an overall graph deadline or hard child memory sandbox
